assumption_notes: 200 input and 60 output tokens per call are assumptions, not measurements; every repeated/check call uses the same assumed token envelope.
1 call forward; 2 calls forward+reverse; 3 calls forward+reverse+checker. A separate QE model is not priced as this API call unless actually used that way.
No prompt-cache savings, no retries/tool/search charges, no hidden reasoning or longer chat history included; token envelope must cover billed tokens.
365 paid usage days plus 30 trial days for every acquired trial user. Trial inference allocated per converter as 30/conversion; trial and paid daily usage assumed equal.

Non-inference allowance $1 per paying subscriber per year is explicitly assumed pooled operating cost, not measured; no additional trial infra, acquisition cost, refunds, bot usage, profit tax or fixed R&D modeled.
Gross price includes modeled VAT; VAT removed before commission applied. Commission15/30 and VAT0/20 are scenarios, not account/tax qualification.
60% contribution margin is defined on net receipts after modeled tax/store commission, before unmodeled fixed costs.
20% cloud routing is assumed availability/choice, not a measured safe local-translation fraction.
48 is the existing Bot mini ADD-ON price requiring Base; scenarios at48 are price sensitivity, not entitlement to spend Bot mini revenue on translation.
